name: @mochi/shared
description: Code shared by the web app and the mobile app: Zod schemas, the bilingual string dictionary, design tokens, date/recurrence logic, and version formatting.
//: This package.json exists ONLY so mobile/ can depend on this directory as `file:../shared`. Expo's forked Metro file map ignores watchFolders outside the project root, so a sibling directory cannot be resolved any other way — see mobile/metro.config.js. The web app imports these files by relative path and is unaffected.
